x: In the men's throws Mick Jones and Greg Beard performed superbly with Greg's 16.17m in the shot heralding a return to form in a big way. Shot putter Eva Massey's 15.71m was not far short of her season's best.
In the javelin Stuart Faben struggled following his ankle injury at Eton but in the shot Greg Beard once again improved his pb to gain silver and more points.

Greg Beard launched the shot to 17.05 metres for yet another third place having set a pb of 17.07m at Ashford the previous day. The Bels had now moved into fourth but with the end of the match in sight, normally cheerful team managers were shaking their heads in despair.
New member Dan Donovan made an impressive start while under 23 year olds Scot Thompson, Greg Beard, Seni Majekodunmi, and Dominic Girdler made significant contributions.
Greg Beard with good rotational technique heaved the 7.26kg weight beyond 15 metres, a mark which he was to better on numerous occasions during the season.
